summary: Apply Excel-based analysis, policy indicators and evaluation methods to public-sector decisions. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Data analytics for government helps policy analysts, programme officers and public-sector planners assess evidence, compare options and monitor delivery. The course covers checking administrative and survey data, defining indicators, summarising results in Excel, and interpreting evaluation evidence, costs and uncertainty. Learners practise turning findings into concise policy briefs without requiring programming.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for public-sector professionals who work with programme, service-delivery or policy evidence and need to explain findings clearly. It suits roles that contribute to policy design, monitoring, evaluation and resource-allocation decisions.
outcomes: Program Evaluation With OECD DAC Criteria
modules: Theory of Change and Logic Models
Policy Briefs and OECD Evaluation Evidence
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with public programmes or policy processes is useful. No coding or prior statistical training is required; basic spreadsheet use will help you complete the Excel exercises.
